conclusions.why_raw_MN_vs_author_MN_rosters_differ: The majority of raw MN codes absent from the author MN encounter matrix occur only in months that fail a conservative exact-three-consecutive-MN-capture-day screen. This is consistent with, but does NOT prove, authors' encounter-session filtering. Five codes remain present in such months and need further provenance.
conclusions.why_author_NA_rows_exist: All 158 NA matrix TOEs can be found with SPECIES=NA in the original CSV; 18 also have MN capture rows. They cannot simply be re-labelled as 158 additional M. natalensis animals.
rejected_rescues: turn NA species rows into MN animals
assume raw TOE strings are known unique biological animals despite potential reuse
exclude five missing codes based on favourable ecological slopes
conclusions.next_action: Target precisely five codes absent from author MN matrix despite being observed in strictly complete months; compare author processing exclusion stages and per-bout inclusion without disclosing codes or opening MNA/WB effects. If no unambiguous provenance, obtain author reconciliation.
